Build prompt

Build “Volunteer Recruitment & Onboarding Hub” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Separate screening files from orientation tasks. Track references, review outcome, invitation expiry, and completion of training. Keep screening material out of general coordinator exports. Applicants submit their own materials. Authorized screeners review restricted files. Approved volunteers use expiring passwordless email links to open their own checklist. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Approving a fictional applicant sends one sample invitation. Its valid link opens only that applicant’s checklist, an expired link is rejected, and a coordinator’s roster export omits screening files.
